title: Prescriptions Training Note: Units Still Held from a Mislabeled Fill
content:
When a Kestrel Prescriptions fill carried wrong directions on the label, the relabel units still held are the units of that mislabeled fill that the relabel remake replaces. They depend on how long after pickup the patient reported the error.

## The rule

The mislabeled pickup date is the event date of the pickup entry that names the mislabeled fill, and spans are counted in calendar days from their first date as day 0. The prescribed daily units are the prescription's written quantity divided by its written days supply.

1. When the report was made **more than 14 days** after the mislabeled pickup date, the relabel units still held are the quantity dispensed on the mislabeled fill less the prescribed daily units multiplied by the days from that pickup date to the report date, never below zero.
2. When the report was made **one day up to 14 days** after that pickup date, they are the quantity dispensed less the prescribed daily units multiplied by the days from that pickup date to the review date, never below zero.
3. Otherwise — a report made on the pickup date — they are the quantity dispensed on the mislabeled fill.

## Input, judgement, output (hypothetical mislabeled fill of 60 units, 2 prescribed daily units, picked up on day 0)

| Report date | Review date | Case | Relabel units still held |
|---|---|---|---|
| day 15 | day 16 | 1 | 60 less 2 multiplied by 15: 30 |
| day 14 | day 17 | 2 | 60 less 2 multiplied by 17: 26 |
| day 1 | day 3 | 2 | 60 less 2 multiplied by 3: 54 |
| day 0 | day 2 | 3 | 60 |
| day 40 | day 41 | 1 | 60 less 80, never below zero: 0 |

**A report on day 14 after pickup.** Fourteen days is not more than 14, so the count runs to the review date, not the report date.
